verdict.rationale: Statsig documents forwarding assignment and event data into the customer's own warehouse, which is a first-party way for core experiment data to end up under the customer's control. The Console API, a CRUD API with a public OpenAPI spec, also lets configuration be read back programmatically. There is no documented 'export all data' feature, and nothing on export formats or completeness, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open-format guarantees (e.g. CSV/Parquet/JSON), coverage of metrics, analytics and config data beyond assignments/events, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful migration off Statsig.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Statsig then forwards that assignment and event data to your warehouse for analysis.
Statsig Warehouse Native is an experimentation platform that runs analysis directly in your data warehouse.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
